easyPrerequisites: You control an untapped land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying {1}{G}, When it enters, its first ability triggers, earthbending a land that can produce at least {U}.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to the earthbent land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Badgermole Cub's second ability triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping the land.
Repeat from step 3.
